scope: Source-only fail-closed projection after the existing PackageCapture read; not installed, not a live package capture, not a quote or booking action

implementation.authority: record() proves only exact package binding; current() first calls existing PackageCapture::read to revalidate current retained context, mapping, expiry and digest before identity_verified may become true
implementation.binding: Exact SHA256 relation between returned claimDocument.catalogKey bytes and retained supplier_offer_sha256; no fuzzy relation, price lookup or first-row fallback
implementation.temporary_offer: Public composition requires claimDocument.condition=ccOffer; booked/prebooking/refusal states are not exposed as selectable offers
implementation.selected_composition: Only claimDocument selected hotel/transport/service rows are projected; variants are not selected orders and only produce a boolean alternatives marker
implementation.tourist_price: Exactly one buyerMoneys.buyerClaimMoney.net plus currency; amount preserved as a decimal string, no float arithmetic/conversion and no agency moneys.money.net/discoCost fallback
implementation.privacy: Raw claim, supplier/catalog/order IDs, buyer/people/client links, provider support, notes, hidden services, variant contents and agency money are excluded
implementation.external_flights: freightExternal>0 only marks requires_external_flights=true; no get_flights call is introduced

checks.fixture: Official-schema-shaped synthetic captured record only; not supplier evidence

source_handoff.note: Existing workflow artifact still contains only the unchanged six #1901 runtime files and is not a new installation candidate; the new projection source is not installed by this PR

approved_capture.permission: One bounded current selected-retained capture, max one broninit
approved_capture.missing_input: Actual current common-preview publicSelection identity plus local country from SEARCH #1646 handoff comment 5623816616
